description: Derelict in the old 904 Squadron hangar at Don Mueang in 1996 coded 40313, at the RTAF Museum 1998-2006 and officially transferred to the school 18 September 2006; coded 71113 then 10213. Marked 91695.
Ex USAF 66-9160. A battle damage repair training airframe at Korat in 2002, preserved there to 2005 and transferred to the school 18 September 2006. Marked 69160 with code 1312.
Really ex USAF 53-0626. Mounted on a pole outside the school's former Bangkok building from at least 1983 marked 30626 / 1213, and re-erected at Nakhon Nayok by 2005.

Displayed in the school grounds on Wireless Road in Bangkok from 1994 and moved to Nakhon Nayok by 2005. Plates in the main gear wells refer to serial no. 040 and contract AF04-606 134 20; true identity unresolved.
Ex USAF 69-6364. Displayed on a pole since 2005 marked 1803, repainted with code 21114 by October 2023.
Ex USAF 55-4569 from the data plate; marked 55-569. Withdrawn at Don Mueang from 1995 and displayed at Nakhon Nayok since 2005.
Ex Royal Thai Police; withdrawn at Don Mueang and converted into a flight simulator in 2014; at Nakhon Nayok since January 2015.
Ex Royal Thai Police, c/n 2116 from the data plate. Stored at Tha Raeng until 2013 and at Nakhon Nayok since January 2015.
